name: UNECE WP.29
sub: GRVA's UN-wide ADS regulation headed to a June 2026 vote
about: UN forum harmonizing global vehicle automation regulations. In 2026 WP.29 adopted the first UN Global Technical Regulation on Automated Driving Systems, jointly led by China, the EU, UK, US, Canada and Japan.
signal: GRVA finalizing UN regulation/GTR on ADS, vote Jun 2026
